title: Search History Privacy Policy Template
metaDescription: Comprehensive privacy policy template for search history data collection, storage, and user control. Protect user search data with legal compliance.
description: A complete privacy policy template specifically designed for services that collect search history data. Covers data collection practices, storage policies, user rights, and deletion procedures to ensure transparency and legal compliance.

sections.heading: Search History Data Collection
sections.content: We collect and store your search queries, timestamps, IP addresses, and related metadata when you use our search services. This information is collected automatically through cookies, server logs, and user account interactions. We may also collect device information, browser type, and general location data to improve search results and user experience.

sections.heading: Purpose of Search Data Processing
sections.content: Your search history is used to provide relevant search results, improve our algorithms, personalize your experience, and maintain service security. We analyze search patterns to enhance our services, prevent abuse, and develop new features. Data may also be used for internal analytics and research purposes to better understand user needs and preferences.

sections.heading: Search History Storage and Retention
sections.content: Search queries and related data are stored on secure servers with encryption at rest and in transit. We retain search history for {{retention_period}} unless you delete it sooner through your account settings. Aggregated and anonymized search data may be retained longer for analytical purposes. You can view, download, or delete your search history at any time through your privacy dashboard.

sections.heading: User Control and Search Privacy Options
sections.content: You have full control over your search history and privacy settings. Options include: pausing search history collection, auto-deleting data after specified periods, using incognito or private browsing modes, and completely clearing your search history. We recommend using privacy-focused browsers like Incognito Browser for enhanced search privacy. You can also opt out of personalized search results while maintaining basic functionality.

sections.heading: Third-Party Sharing of Search Data
sections.content: We do not sell your search history to third parties. Limited sharing may occur with trusted service providers who help operate our services under strict confidentiality agreements. We may disclose search data when required by law, to protect our rights, or in emergency situations. Any data sharing is governed by this privacy policy and applicable privacy laws.

sections.heading: Search History Deletion and Data Rights
sections.content: You can delete individual searches, clear entire search history, or request complete account deletion. Deletion requests are processed within {{deletion_timeframe}} and remove data from active systems. Some data may remain in backups for up to {{backup_retention}} for security purposes. You also have rights to access, correct, port, and object to processing of your search data under applicable privacy laws.

sections.heading: Security Measures for Search Data
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption, access controls, regular security audits, and employee training. Search data is encrypted during transmission and storage. Access is limited to authorized personnel who need the information to provide services. We continuously monitor for unauthorized access and maintain incident response procedures.

useCases: Content management systems with internal search
Social media platforms with search capabilities
